sections.title: CONCLUSION
sections.text_preview: In this paper, a 29-GHz power amplifier using 180-nm CMOS technology has been designed, fabricated and measured. It has a small signal gain 12.6 dB at 29-GHz with 13 dBm output saturation power and highest PAE about 25.3%. A 29-GHz power amplifier using 150-nm GaAs p-HEMT technology has been designed.
